kamloops.title: Animal sanctuary among evacuees of Summerland wildfire
kamloops.description: Faith Affleck runs Stars Piggly Wigglys Sanctuary in Summerland and is currently staying in Okanagan Falls with two of her rescues.

kamloops.title: Summerland wildfire: Planning for re-entry already underway, but now is not the time
kamloops.description: This briefing comes as thousands of people remain out of their homes due to the Bald Range wildfire, which sparked on Friday afternoon.

kamloops.title: Videos capture aftermath of Summerland fire in Faulder, residents say it was ‘eerie’
kamloops.description: The blaze broke out on Friday afternoon near Summerland and grew quickly to 5,000 hectares in only a few hours. It is now mapped at more than 15,500 hectares.

kamloops.title: Cause of Summerland wildfire under investigation as RCMP examine reports of suspicious activity
kamloops.description: The Penticton RCMP, along with neighbouring RCMP detachments, are actively patrolling areas currently within the evacuation order, checking in on properties and businesses.

kamloops.title: Seniors forced to flee B.C. wildfire found safe due to Apple AirTag, help from strangers
kamloops.description: Helen Gonzalez said she and her sister didn't know what to do until she remembered that their dog, Christy, had an Apple AirTag on her collar.

kamloops.title: Why did the ‘absolutely shocking’ B.C. wildfire intensify so fast?
kamloops.description: Starting about 15 km northwest of Summerland last Friday, the Bald Ridge wildfire quickly grew to 50 square kilometres in just three hours after it was first detected.

kamloops.title: Summerland farmers return to wildfire evacuation zone to care for their animals
kamloops.description: Minister of Agriculture Lana Popham said the Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen established a pass system specifically for farmers and ranchers to relocate livestock.

all.title: Off-road vehicles banned on Crown land in many parts of B.C. as wildfires burn
all.description: This prohibition does not apply to emergency response, agriculture or commercial/industrial users who operate off-road vehicles for farming or business purposes.
